scientific_integrity: The 2026 antecedent proves per-pattern avoidance existence; the asserted refinement is the exact overlap correction, fiber exception count, and conditional probability. Gaussian two-deck class sizes and partition models are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: The formula is exact for A,B>=3 and three-letter scattered-subsequence universality. It does not count avoidance of longer scattered patterns or cover smaller multiplicities without separate treatment. Independent external validation and definitive priority assessment remain outstanding.
title: Exact three-subsequence-universality frequencies inside every binary two-deck class
